newsitem.title: USA: Lilly unit in salmonella prevention program.
newsitem.headline: Lilly unit in salmonella prevention program.

text.p: Elanco Animal Health, a unit of Eli Lilly and Co, said Friday it signed a research and marketing agreement with the MS-BioScience unit of Milk Specialties Co covering a microbial product engineered to prevent salmonella in live poultry.
The partners say the product CF-3 uses a continuous-flow culture system that helps produce the types of bacteria that fend off salmonella bacteria in the digestive system of mature chickens.
Laboratory studies and field trials demonstrated a significant reduction in the presence of salmonella bacteria in the intestines of treated birds, the companies said.
Financial terms of the agreement were not announced.
